name: The Front
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The open-world survival shooter where you fight a tyrannical empire, build and craft. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated.
startup: if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $([ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && echo validate) +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; exec ./ProjectWar/Binaries/Linux/TheFrontServer "ProjectWar_Start?DedicatedServer" -server -game -log -Port={{SERVER_PORT}} -BeaconPort={{BEACON_PORT}} -QueryPort={{QUERY_PORT}} -ShutDownServicePort={{SHUTDOWN_PORT}} -OutIPAddress={{SERVER_IP}} -UseSteamSocket={{STEAMSOCKET}} -ConfigServerName="{{CFG_NAME}}" -UserDir="/home/container/TheFrontManager/{{CFG_NAME}}/" -ServerName="{{SRV_NAME}}" -ServerTags="{{SRV_TAGS}}" -EnableParallelCharacterMovementTickFunction -EnableParallelCharacterTickFunction -UseDynamicPhysicsScene -Game.PhysicsVehicle=false -ansimalloc -Game.MaxFrameRate=35 -MaxQueueSize=50 -QueueValidTime=120 -QueueThreshold={{MAX_PLAYERS}} -ServerFightModeType={{GAMEMODE}} -IsCanSelfDamage={{SELFDMG}} -IsCanFriendDamage={{DMGALLIES}} -SaveWorldInterval={{SRV_SAVETIME}} -GMOverlapRatio=2 -GreenHand={{GREENHAND}} -SensitiveWords={{SENSITIVE_WORDS}} -UseACE={{ANTI_CHEAT}} -ServerAdminAccounts="{{SRV_ADMIN}}" -IsShowGmTitle={{ADMIN_LABEL}} -ServerPassword="{{SRV_PW}}"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# The Front. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 2334200)
# with SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. Saves and settings (TheFrontManager/)
# are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-2334200}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

echo "Installed The Front build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Save name
variables.description: The folder in TheFrontManager the world and its settings are kept in.

variables.name: PvE
variables.description: On makes the server player-versus-environment; off, player-versus-player.

variables.name: Self damage
variables.description: true lets players damage themselves.

variables.name: Friendly fire
variables.description: true lets squadmates damage each other.

variables.name: Newcomer protection
variables.description: true protects new characters for a while.

variables.name: Save interval
variables.description: How often the world is saved, in seconds.

variables.name: Admins
variables.description: The 17-digit Steam IDs of the server's admins, separated by semicolons.

variables.name: Admin badge
variables.description: true shows a badge next to admins' names.

variables.name: Server tags
variables.description: Up to 5 tags, separated by commas: 0 PvP, 1 PvE, 2 XP multiplier, 3 gathering rate, 4 keep inventory, 5 to 8 wipes every 45, 15, 30 or 60 days.

variables.name: Anti-cheat
variables.description: true turns on the game's anti-cheat.

variables.name: Chat filter
variables.description: true filters offensive words in chat.

variables.name: Steam networking
variables.description: Relay connections through Steam, for a server without a public address.

variables.name: Beacon port
variables.description: The port players' clients first connect to; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The port Steam's server queries use; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Shutdown port
variables.description: The port the game's shutdown service listens on; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
